title: Himarimã language - Wikipedia
text: Himarimã is the presumed language of the uncontacted Hi-Merimã people in Amazonas, Brazil. A contact may have happened in 2007. [2] A wordlist was recorded, but was later lost. [3] The language is believed to be Arawán per testimonies from the Suruwahá and Banawá. [4][5]

title: Himarimã - Wikipedia
text: The Himarimã or Hi-Merimã are an Indigenous people of Brazil. They are largely uncontacted by outside society, and live along the Pinhuã River, between the Juruá and Purus Rivers, in the state of Amazonas.
